notes:
Inbound PLG signup from indie dev duo building a Notion-like personal knowledge app. Primary ask: affordable hosted API to power search + chat + code-aware assistance inside web app. Signed up via the quickstart, completed API key creation and one small test embedding run (~1k docs).

Founder quotes: "we want something that 'just works' — low friction SDK + clear cost controls. Not looking to host yet."

Behavior observed: used free credits within first 48h (embedding-heavy), triggered rate-limit on 2nd day when running batch re-index job. No AE outreach; Jordan (AE) marked as owner to monitor potential conversion but current motion is self-serve.

Preference notes: prefers smaller quantized open models for cost, but wants fallback to higher-quality if generation quality drops. Willing to accept minor latency for lower cost on embeddings, but chat responses to end-users should be <500ms p95.

Possible upsell later: Dedicated or reserved capacity only if growth/paid conversion happens (unlikely in first 6 months).
